findings.evidence: grep `OrdConnected` in TauCeti/Algebra/Polynomial/Thom.lean gives only line 212. Roadmap RealAlgebraicGeometry/README.md:217-221 states Thom's lemma for the finite list `p,p',…,p^(degree p)` and asks for "restriction, realizability, reconstruction, and comparison APIs"; the finite-word order-convexity is the restriction/realizability half and is absent.
findings.fix: Add `theorem ordConnected_preimage_thomEncoding (p : R[X]) (hrolle : PolynomialRolle R) (τ : Fin p.natDegree → SignType) : OrdConnected (thomEncoding p ⁻¹' {τ})`. It follows from `derivativeSign_eq_on_Icc` applied to `derivative p` (via `Function.iterate_one` and `thomEncoding_eq_iff`), needing no new hypotheses.
findings.issue: `ordConnected_preimage_derivativeSign` is stated only for the ℕ-indexed `derivativeSign`; there is no counterpart for `thomEncoding`. Every other ℕ-form result has a Fin-form wrapper (injOn 243, lt_iff 317, succ_ne_zero 345, exists 393), so a consumer holding a finite Thom word — the roadmap's named object and the one used in SignDetermination/Thom.lean:40 — is the only case left to redo the index shuffle by hand.

findings.evidence: Mathlib marks only the zero case: `mathlib/Mathlib/Basic/Sign/Defs.lean:311` `@[simp]` before `sign_eq_zero_iff:312`, while `sign_eq_one_iff:287` and `sign_eq_neg_one_iff:293` carry no attribute.
findings.fix: Drop `@[simp]` from `derivativeSign_eq_one_iff` and `derivativeSign_eq_neg_one_iff`, keeping `grind =` on both; retain `@[simp]` on `derivativeSign_eq_zero_iff` (62), which matches Mathlib.
findings.issue: `@[simp]` on `derivativeSign_eq_one_iff` (51) and `derivativeSign_eq_neg_one_iff` (56) rewrites `derivativeSign p x k = 1` to `0 < (derivative^[k] p).eval x`. Combined with `@[simp] thomEncoding_apply` (102), a single `simp` destroys the RHS of `lt_iff_derivativeSign` (287-288), `lt_iff_thomEncoding` (322-324), `derivativeSign_succ_ne_zero` (334) and `thomEncoding_succ_ne_zero` (349) — the file's own results are not simp-normal under its own simp set, and there is no lemma folding back.

summary: The prior round's missing thomEncoding/derivativeSign link is closed by thomEncoding_eq_iff. Two gaps remain: no order-convexity lemma for thomEncoding preimages (the one ℕ-form result with no Fin counterpart), and simp annotations on the `= 1`/`= -1` sign iffs that normalize the new abstraction away from the form the file's own main theorems use.
